integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 53 file changes, 8 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: A finished, charming ecology toy: the garden reads as alive, the live chart is on screen from the first second, and the preset descriptions explain cause and effect. Thin on engineering hygiene.

standards.summary: 3,975 lines across 19 files with a seeded RNG and a clean sim/ui split, but no tests, no ARIA and only eight verification actions.

findings.title: No automated tests on the simulation core
findings.detail: src/sim/world.ts is 924 lines of energy accounting, reproduction thresholds and foraging decisions, and none of it is covered. The brief explicitly requires that the waves emerge from the rules rather than being faked, which is exactly the property a seeded test can assert. Add a test that runs a fixed seed for N ticks and asserts the populations oscillate out of phase.

findings.title: No ARIA anywhere
findings.detail: The app has zero aria- or role attributes. Every slider, preset button and transport control is unlabelled for assistive technology.

strengths: Seeded RNG module, so a run is reproducible from its seed
sim/, ui/ and analysis/ each own one concern
world.ts, scene.ts and the React layer never reach into each other's state

specification.summary: The round rotatable dish, the fruit trees, the two blob groups, the five named presets, the inspector and the fruit/blue/red timeline are all delivered and driven by the simulation.

findings.title: No phase plot or trait trends
findings.detail: The brief lists a blue-vs-red phase plot and trait trends as helpful extra views. The main timeline is present and correct; these two are absent.

strengths: All five requested presets with descriptions that state the expected dynamic
Live counters for blue, red and fruit plus a speed multiplier
Play, pause, step, reset and randomize all present
Control labels explain what each parameter does in plain language

ux.summary: The most charming surface of the two: a lush green dish, blobs with faces and soft shadows, and a chart that is already recording six samples two seconds in.

findings.title: Inspector panel is empty until a blob is clicked
findings.detail: The Selected Blob card holds instructional copy and occupies prime vertical space before anything is selected. Auto-select an interesting blob on load so the panel demonstrates itself.

strengths: Green dish with a raised rim and soft shadows reads as a tabletop world
Blob faces, glow and shading give the characters personality
Timeline chart with an explicit dual-axis legend
Drag-to-spin and click-to-inspect affordance stated on the canvas
